statement: fpbench is a personal educational research project. It exists so that one person can learn how fingerprint recognition systems are measured, by running them locally on one machine. It is not a product, not a service, and not an academic submission. It makes no commercial use of any third-party component, deploys nothing commercially, offers no commercial service, redistributes no third-party bytes, sublicenses nothing, and does not treat publication of its benchmark as an academic work.
